```yaml
name: E2E Flows Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED: ${{ github.event.inputs.enable_e2e_flows || 'false' }}

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Configure ngrok
        run: |
          echo "ngrok_auth_token=${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Start ngrok tunnel
        id: start_ngrok
        run: |
          ./node_modules/.bin/ngrok http 3000 --auth=$ngrok_auth_token --log=stdout > /dev/null &
          sleep 5
          echo "::set-output name=ngrok_url::$(curl -s http://localhost:4040/api/tunnels | jq -r '.tunnels[0].public_url')"

      - name: Set up test environment variables
        run: |
          echo "E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL=${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL=${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: pnpm test-e2e:flows -- --baseUrl=$(echo "${{ steps.start_ngrok.outputs.ngrok_url }}")

      - name: Teardown ngrok tunnel
        run: |
          curl -X DELETE $(echo "${{ steps.start_ngrok.outputs.ngrok_url }}/api/tunnels" | sed 's|http://localhost:4040||')
```
